siteUrlNote: Canonical host for an eventual approved migration. The concept build is not deployed there.
noindexNote: The concept build must not be indexed while it lives on a preview or staging host. Set to false only when the business approves a production launch on siteUrl; robots.txt follows this same flag.

analytics.note: No analytics is loaded. Add a deferred script tag at the integration point marked in scripts/lib/layout.mjs.

assistant.note: Integration point for a future AI Employee. When enabled, the build emits a mount node and a deferred module hook. No vendor is named or contacted, and nothing is advertised on the site while this is false.

forms.note: No enquiry backend is connected. src/js/enquiry.js posts to this endpoint when set; until then it runs in development mode and never reports success.
